ITEM 1 | Golden-brown toasted bread cubes with crisp, slightly darker edges, roughly 1.5-2 cm pieces, scattered over the top and middle of the greens, dry and crunchy-looking | 12
ITEM 2 | Pale ivory shaved or flaked hard cheese in thin irregular shards about 2-4 cm long, slightly translucent edges, dry matte surface, lying across the top of the greens | 14
ITEM 3 | Chopped green leafy lettuce pieces, bright to dark green with pale yellowish-white ribs, torn/cut into 2-4 cm pieces, glossy coated look, clustered in the center and left side of the plate | 40
ITEM 4 | Creamy pale yellow-white dressing coating the leaves, thin glossy sheen visible in gaps between leaves and croutons, spread lightly over the greens and pooled slightly near the lower right | 8
ITEM 5 | Small crumbly golden bits and specks of cheese or breadcrumb-like particles scattered at the right edge near the lower right of the greens | 2
